abstract: Monitors ecological discharge compliance and environmental risk mitigation
system_message:
You are the Catchment environmental protection officer (ENVRISK), responsible for monitoring ecological discharge compliance, evaluating environmental risk mitigation protocols, and tracking riparian receiving stream conditions across forensic investigation candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors ecological discharge compliance and environmental risk mitigation（ECOLMIT）
information_points.content:
ENVRISK-ECOLMIT-I9U：For the Microgravimetric mapping and isotopic tracer injection plan, environmental impact mitigation compliance is false, as tracer containment and surface runoff protocols within the catchment protection buffer zone around the municipal aqueduct failed to meet standards.
ENVRISK-ECOLMIT-24F：For the Cross-borehole radar and hydrophone tomography plan, environmental impact mitigation compliance is confirmed true based on an assessment of tracer containment and surface runoff protocols within the catchment protection buffer zone around the municipal aqueduct.
ENVRISK-ECOLMIT-6UL：For the Distributed acoustic sensing and dye-dilution profiling plan, environmental impact mitigation compliance is confirmed true based on an assessment of tracer containment and surface runoff protocols within the catchment protection buffer zone around the municipal aqueduct.

information_points.title: Runoff turbidity monitoring（TURBMON）
information_points.content:
ENVRISK-TURBMON-IYC：Under the Microgravimetric mapping and isotopic tracer injection plan, the receiving stream baseline turbidity is recorded at 9 NTU, measured as the average diurnal nephelometric turbidity in the riparian receiving zone 50 m downstream of the drainage spillway prior to testing.
ENVRISK-TURBMON-04Z：Under the Distributed acoustic sensing and dye-dilution profiling plan, the receiving stream baseline turbidity is recorded at 16 NTU, measured as the average diurnal nephelometric turbidity in the riparian receiving zone 50 m downstream of the drainage spillway prior to testing.
ENVRISK-TURBMON-UTC：Under the Cross-borehole radar and hydrophone tomography plan, the receiving stream baseline turbidity is recorded at 4 NTU, measured as the average diurnal nephelometric turbidity in the riparian receiving zone 50 m downstream of the drainage spillway prior to testing.
